_source: 逐镜复刻《11月17日 (2).mp4》（海滨黄昏 · 睦子与祥子）
_spec: 按 skills/prompt/group-master 规范编写；段 2 起由插件自动加续写开关三组件

segments.title: 大全景 · 并肩走向海
segments.body:
This is the opening segment, so the first second stands free of any carried overlap and it is fully authored. Every action below begins at the first frame.

[Shot 1] A static wide shot from behind. Two girls walk side by side away from camera along the seaside promenade, heading toward the water, their backs to us, shoulder width about one hand apart. the shorter girl on screen-left. Long straight grey-green hair past the waist with a blunt fringe; a single narrow light-green hairpin sits above her left ear against that same grey-green hair, and the right side of her head is bare. Amber eyes, thick lashes. Cream-white blazer over a black top, deep green pleated skirt, black tights, black ankle boots. She is on screen-left. the taller girl on screen-right. Long grey-blue hair past the waist with a blunt fringe, the right side gathered into a small braid tied with a black-and-yellow diagonal-striped ribbon. Amber eyes, sharp gaze. Grey tartan long-sleeved dress to the ankle, white shirt collar, thin black neck bow, thin black belt. She is on screen-right.

They walk at an unhurried, even pace — roughly one step per second, arms hanging relaxed, both gazes fixed ahead toward the water. Their shadows stretch forward-left across the pale stone slabs. The camera stays perfectly static for the whole beat, letting them recede slightly into the frame, holding one fixed framing throughout.

The key light is the low sun over the sea, eight degrees above the horizon. It lays a hard-edged warm highlight along the sea-side contour of heads, shoulders and hair, while the land side falls into flat block cel shadow at a four-to-one ratio whose boundary with the lit zone is a single hard edge, carrying a crisp painted-cel finish. Sea haze fills the air, so the backlight reads as visible shafts between the railing balusters, with fine motes drifting slowly through the beams. Cotton, wool and jacket fabric render as strictly flat matte cel fills with block shadow and a uniform dull surface. The white railing returns a soft painted-metal sheen. The bench wood keeps a flat matte finish with visible grain. The sea carries a hard-edged glitter path built from separate bright strokes. Every highlight is a single hard edge that stays inside its own shape, with a clean flat cel-painted surface throughout and a uniformly crisp graphic finish. The sky is a warm sunset gradient from pale gold at the horizon through warm orange to muted violet, with one low dark cloud band just above the waterline.

The location is the same seaside promenade at sunset: pale stone paving slabs, a white painted-metal railing along the sea side, a row of black lamp posts on the land side, clipped round green shrubs behind them, one folded cream-white parasol, one dark cylindrical bin, and one wooden bench. The sea horizon is dead straight and level with the subjects’ shoulders. A single low cloud band floats just above the waterline. The sky reads as a warm sunset gradient only—pale gold at the horizon through warm orange to muted violet—filling the entire upper frame.

Sound is sea surf breaking in a slow regular cycle about six seconds long, distant gulls, and a faint high wind, with the two girls staying silent.
segments.soundscape: Sea surf breaking slowly and regularly against the sea wall below, distant gulls calling once or twice, a faint high wind over open water, no voices.

segments.title: 中近景 · 侧脸看海
segments.body:
[Shot 2] The camera cuts to a medium close two-shot in side view. The first second continues the carried walk as pure continuation, and the stop begins at the one-second mark. Then both girls stop walking and settle into stillness as one continuous move, holding a constant distance and constant side-view angle, settling into stillness at a fixed framing.

Both faces are turned toward screen-left, looking out over the water. the shorter girl on screen-left. Long straight grey-green hair past the waist with a blunt fringe; a single narrow light-green hairpin sits above her left ear against that same grey-green hair, and the right side of her head is bare. Amber eyes, thick lashes. Cream-white blazer over a black top, deep green pleated skirt, black tights, black ankle boots. the taller girl on screen-right. Long grey-blue hair past the waist with a blunt fringe, the right side gathered into a small braid tied with a black-and-yellow diagonal-striped ribbon. Amber eyes, sharp gaze. Grey tartan long-sleeved dress to the ankle, white shirt collar, thin black neck bow, thin black belt. The two stand close, Mutsumi very slightly forward of Sakiko. Their expressions are calm and unreadable; both stay silent and both keep facing the water.

The key light is the low sun over the sea, eight degrees above the horizon. It lays a hard-edged warm highlight along the sea-side contour of heads, shoulders and hair, while the land side falls into flat block cel shadow at a five-to-one ratio whose boundary with the lit zone is a single hard edge, carrying a crisp painted-cel finish. Sea haze fills the air, so the backlight reads as visible shafts between the railing balusters, with fine motes drifting slowly through the beams. Cotton, wool and jacket fabric render as strictly flat matte cel fills with block shadow and a uniform dull surface. The white railing returns a soft painted-metal sheen. The bench wood keeps a flat matte finish with visible grain. The sea carries a hard-edged glitter path built from separate bright strokes. Every highlight is a single hard edge that stays inside its own shape, with a clean flat cel-painted surface throughout and a uniformly crisp graphic finish. The sky is a warm sunset gradient from pale gold at the horizon through warm orange to muted violet, with one low dark cloud band just above the waterline. Because the sun is now behind them, a bright rim traces the sea-side contour of both faces while the front planes stay in soft reflected fill; a faint cel-shaded blush sits high on each cheek.

The location is the same seaside promenade at sunset: pale stone paving slabs, a white painted-metal railing along the sea side, a row of black lamp posts on the land side, clipped round green shrubs behind them, one folded cream-white parasol, one dark cylindrical bin, and one wooden bench. The sea horizon is dead straight and level with the subjects’ shoulders. A single low cloud band floats just above the waterline. The sky reads as a warm sunset gradient only—pale gold at the horizon through warm orange to muted violet—filling the entire upper frame. The railing now crosses the lower quarter of frame.

Sound thins as the camera comes closer: the surf drops in level, the wind recedes, and the remaining bed is a soft low room tone with one distant gull.
segments.soundscape: Surf receding into a soft low bed, one distant gull, gentle wind, no voices.

segments.title: 中景 · 睦子坐下
segments.body:
[Shot 3] The camera cuts to a medium shot, both figures framed knee-up. The first second continues the carried standing as pure continuation, and the sit begins at the one-second mark. Then Mutsumi lowers herself onto the wooden bench in one continuous motion — she bends at the hips, reaches back with her right hand to find the bench edge, and settles her weight down, her pleated skirt opening slightly with the movement. Sakiko stays standing beside her and turns her upper body a little toward Mutsumi staying planted in place.

Grey tartan long-sleeved dress to the ankle, white shirt collar, thin black neck bow, thin black belt. The dark cylindrical bin and the folded parasol pole sit at frame-left behind Mutsumi. The camera holds a static frame; the only movement is the small downward reframe that tracks Mutsumi as she sits.

segments.soundscape: Cloth rustling, a quiet wooden creak from the bench, sea surf continuing underneath, no voices.

segments.title: 中景 · 并坐
segments.body:
[Shot 4] The camera cuts back to a medium two-shot, three-quarter side view. The first second continues the carried seated hand position as pure continuation, and the settle begins at the one-second mark. Then both settle: Mutsumi rests both hands on her own knees and lets her shoulders drop; Sakiko folds her hands together in her lap and straightens her back. Both keep their gaze toward screen-left, out over the water, and neither turns her head.

the shorter girl on screen-left. Grey tartan long-sleeved dress to the ankle, white shirt collar, thin black neck bow, thin black belt. The parasol canopy forms a flat cream-white backdrop block behind them; the bin sits at frame-left of Mutsumi. The railing crosses behind both figures and the sun and sea remain visible through its uprights. Mutsumi’s skirt hem falls over the bench edge and a soft curved highlight sits across the top of her knee.

segments.title: 特写 · 触碰与回应
segments.body:
[Shot 5] The camera cuts to an extreme close-up of Mutsumi’s black-tight-covered thigh filling two thirds of the frame. The first second continues the carried seated state as pure continuation. Then Sakiko’s hand enters from frame-right: first her left hand from above, four fingers together, fingertips settling on the upper thigh; then her right hand from the side, fingers spreading, the tips coming to rest against the outer curve. Each hand rests with gentle weight, presses; both simply arrive and stay.

The camera performs one very slow push-in across the whole beat, holding a constant angle and holding one continuous framing. A long diagonal specular streak runs across the black fabric and narrows where the fingertips meet it.

The background is defocused: the horizontal slats of the bench, the vertical uprights of the railing, and a scatter of water glints.

This beat runs at six-to-one contrast. The key light comes from behind frame-right at sunset angle, placing hard-edged warm highlights on the backs of the fingers and along the fabric streak, while the undersides of the hands fall into flat deep cel shadow that still holds skin texture at the knuckles. Every highlight is a single hard edge that stays inside its own shape, with a clean flat cel-painted surface and a uniformly crisp painted finish.

Sound thins almost to nothing, leaving only the faintest surf and the smallest brush of fabric.
segments.soundscape: Almost silence: the faintest surf far away, a single small brush of fabric against fabric, no voices, no music.

segments.title: 特写 · 睦子的笑
segments.body:
[Shot 6] The camera cuts to an extreme close-up of Mutsumi’s face, filling the frame, seen from slightly below in a three-quarter view. The first second continues the carried facial pose as pure continuation. Then her expression shifts: the corners of her mouth lift into a small, restrained, almost knowing smile, and her eyelids lower very slightly. She does not speak.

the shorter girl on screen-left. Long straight grey-green hair past the waist with a blunt fringe; a single narrow light-green hairpin sits above her left ear against that same grey-green hair, and the right side of her head is bare. Amber eyes, thick lashes. Cream-white blazer over a black top, deep green pleated skirt, black tights, black ankle boots. Her fringe strands fall across her forehead and a few fine hairs lie against her cheek. Her amber irises carry a warm orange pinpoint reflection from the low sun. A cel-shaded blush spreads across her cheeks and fades toward her jaw. At the lower edge of frame Sakiko’s hand enters from outside and hovers near her cheek hovering just off the skin. The edge of the light-green hairpin is visible at frame-right.

This beat runs at six-to-one contrast. The low sun now strikes from screen-left, so the upper half of her face is lit and the lower half falls into flat block cel shadow, with a single hard boundary that keeps her eye and eyelash detail clear. Hard-edged highlights sit on the bridge of her nose, her cheekbone and her lower lip. Every highlight is a single hard edge that stays inside its own shape, with glow overlay.

The background is a soft out-of-focus field of the sunset sky in pale gold and warm orange with one low dark cloud band filling the entire upper frame with sunset colour only.

The camera holds nearly still with only a whisper of push-in. Sound is the surf returning gently as the music fades out.
segments.soundscape: Surf returning gently, one distant gull, then the ambient music fades to nothing.
